mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand cycle, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO declines > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for residential construction, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate a tightening monetary policy cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both increase, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 jobs signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS rises > 100,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
